paths.label: Reference controls
paths.description: UVM4 is the PSR1 study control. The preconditioning study has its own strain/condition controls; these do not form a shared cross-study baseline.

paths.label: PSR1 expression regulation
paths.description: Examine reported uptake and growth summaries against UVM4 within one source study. No organism engineering is performed.

paths.label: Nutrient preconditioning
paths.description: Examine source-specific nutrient context and endpoint coverage, retaining qualitative and missing numeric states.

evidence.locator: Results 2.5, printed page 5; Figure 7; Discussion printed pages 7-8
evidence.statement: Complete-nutrient repletion supported greater medium phosphate removal than phosphate-only repletion in the reported preconditioning comparisons.
evidence.measurement_basis: Source-specific deprivation/repletion comparisons; each strain and condition retains its own baseline.
evidence.claim_limit: No numeric removal values admitted. Medium removal is distinct from harvested-product phosphorus recovery.

evidence.locator: Results 2.3, printed page 4; Discussion printed page 7; Figures 4-5
evidence.statement: Growth resumed with complete-nutrient repletion; phosphate-only repletion did not provide the same growth response in the reported comparisons.
evidence.measurement_basis: Published nutrient-deprivation/repletion context; no new study conditions are prescribed.
evidence.claim_limit: Qualitative admission only; cannot compute a cross-study growth contrast or establish equivalence.

limits: Open-evidence literature review; not a hidden-data evaluation or independent experimental reproduction.
Source appraisal is limited to the named admissions; neither paper is a qualified field-deployment or recovered-product dataset.
No significance, growth-equivalence, causal-engineering or cross-study superiority conclusion is computed.
